questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: A crystal made up of particles X, Y, and Z. X forms fcc packing. Y occupies all octahedral voids of X and Z occupies all tetrahedral voids of X. It all particles along one body diagonal are removed, then the formula of the crystal is
questions.solution:
For fcc, number of X atoms = 4/unit cell

Number of Tetrahedral Voids = Z = 8

Number of Octahedral Voids = Y = 4

Number of atoms removed along one body diagonal = 2X (corner) and 2Z (TVs) and 1 Y (OV at body centre)

∴ Number of X atoms left = 4 - 2 × 1 8 = 1 5 4

Number of Y atom left = 4 - (1 × 1) = 3

Number of Z atom left = 8 - (2 × 1) = 6

The simplest formula = X 1 5 4 Y 3 Z 6 ⇒ X 1 5 Y 1 2 Z 2 4
                                                      ⇒ X 5 Y 4 Z 8

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: What is the simplest formula of a solid whose unit cell has the atom A at each corner, the atom B at each face centre and a C atom at the body centre?
questions.solution:
An atom at the corner of a cube is shared among 8 unit cells. As there are 8 corners in a cube, number of corner
atom A per unit cell 8×18=1
Face-centred atom in a cube is shared by two unit cells.
As there are 6 faces in a cube, number of face-centred
atom B per unit cell 6×12=3
An atom in the body of the cube is not shared by other cells.
∴ Number of atoms C at the body centre per unit cell = 1.
Hence, the formula of the solid is AB3C .

questions.solution:
A face centred cubic unit cell contains four atoms. Schottky defect is basically a vacancy defect in ionic solids. Due to Schottky defects, the vacant spaces will increase, resulting in decrease in number of atoms per unit cell.
Thus, number of atoms will reduce to:
Z= 4− 4×0.1 100 =3.996
The density of the metal can be calculated by:
ρ =  Z × M N 0  ×  a 3
Where, M is the molecular mass of calcium = 40 g mol -1
N 0 is the Avogadro number =6.022× 10 23 mol - 1
a is the edge length = 0.560 nm  =  0.56 ×  10 −7 cm
Putting the values in the formula above:
=  3.996 × (40 g  mol −1 ) (0.560 ×  10 −7  cm) 3  × (6.022 ×  10 23   mol −1 )
=1.51 g  cm −3

Hence the resultant stoichiometry is A3B4

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The spinel structure consists of an array of <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> ions in fcc arrangement. General formula of spinel is <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> . Cations of A occupy 1/8th the tetrahedral voids and cations of B ions occupy half of the octahedral voids. If oxide ions are replaced by <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> ions then number of an ionic vacancy per unit cell will be
questions.solution:
These are four O2- ions in the unit cell; let these ions are replaced by n, X-8/3 ions.
Charge of O2- ions = Charge of X-8/3 ions
4(-2) = n (-8/3)
n = 3 (i.e., there will one anionic vacancy)
Thus, there will be one an ionic vacancy per unit cell.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: A metallic element crystallizes into a lattice containing a sequence layers of ABABAB ..... . Any packing of spheres leaves out voids in the lattice. What percentage by volume of this lattice is empty space?
questions.solution:
Packing fraction in hcp =6×43πr3Volume

=6×4πr33×Area×Height

Area (of base) of unit cell in hcp =63r2 (follow text)

height of unit cell in hcp =4r×23 (follow text)

So packing fraction =6×4πr33×63r2×4r×23

=π32=0.74

or = 74%

Thus, empty space in hcp = 1 - 0.74 = 0.26

or = 26%.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: On application of pressure certain crystals can produce electric signals. This phenomenon is known as
questions.solution: When polar crystal is subjected to a mechanical stress, electricity is produced - a case of piezoelectricity. Reversely, if electric field is applied, mechanical stress is developed. Piezoelectric crystal acts as a mechanical electrical transductor.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: In a solid 'XY' having the NaCl structure, 'X' atoms occupy the corners of the cubic unit cell. If all the face centred atoms along one of the axes are removed, then the resultant stiochiometry of the solid is found to be <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msub></math> . Find the sum of m + n?
questions.solution:
Na in NaCl has eight corner and six face atoms and thus, if we remove face centred atom of one axis, then two faces atoms are removed. Thus, X is at 8 corners and Y is at 4 faces.
Number of X atoms per unit cell =8×18+4×12=3
Number of Y atoms per unit cell =12×14+1=4
Thus, formula is X3Y4 .
Hence, m = 3, n = 4
sum of m + n = 3 + 4 = 7.
